# Handle errors / Errors / Troubleshooting

## Handle errors

Source: <https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/handle-errors>

Every error has the same shape, and your code decides what to do from `error.code`. For each error, you do one of three things: fix the request, send the same request again with the same key, or send a new request with a new key.

### 1. Log the request ID

Every response from the API carries an `x-request-id` header, errors and successes alike. The exception is a request too malformed for the API to read, such as one with oversized headers, which our web server answers before the API sees it. Log it with your own record of the request. It's the first thing we ask for when you [report a problem](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support#report-a-problem).

### 2. Branch on the code

Read `error.code`, never `message`: `message` is written for people and can change. `type` groups codes into categories. The [error reference](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/errors) lists every code with its status and type.

Three fields add detail when they apply:

| Field | When it's there |
|---|---|
| `param` | The error concerns one field of your request. It names the field, never its value. |
| `reject_reason` | The broker or the exchange refused an order, an application or an allocation. It says why. |
| `order`, `application`, `allocation` | The error concerns one of your orders, applications or allocations. The field holds its `id`. |

### 3. Decide: fix, retry or resend

What decides it is whether we stored your request. The [idempotency page](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/idempotency#when-to-use-a-new-key) says, code by code, whether we did and what to do.

When a response carries a `Retry-After` header, wait that many seconds before you send the request again.

> **Warning.**
> After a timeout or a `5xx`, send the same request with the same key, unless the code tells you to use a new one. A new key is a new request, and for an order that means a second order at the exchange.

### 4. Back off between retries

A `5xx` without a `Retry-After` header doesn't say how long to wait, so back off:

1. Wait 1 second before the first retry.
2. Double the wait after each failure, and add a random jitter to it, so your retries don't arrive in step with other clients'.
3. Wait no more than 60 seconds between attempts.
4. After about 5 minutes of failures, stop. Establish the outcome of the request before you do anything else: retrieve the object if you have its `id`, or list by your `client_reference`. If the outcome is still unclear, [report the problem](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support#report-a-problem).

For a request that takes an `Idempotency-Key`, every retry uses the same key, so however many times you retry, the request is done once.

### 5. Keep a default for unrecognised codes

We can add codes to `v1` (see [Versioning](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/versioning)), so give every status a safe default:

| Status | Default for an unknown code |
|---|---|
| `409` | Don't send it with a new key. Retrieve the object the error's `order`, `application` or `allocation` names, if there is one. |
| `429` | Wait `Retry-After` seconds, then send the same request with the same key. |
| Any other `4xx` | Don't send it again as it is. Log it, with its `x-request-id`. |
| `5xx` | Send the same request again with the same key, [backing off](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/handle-errors#4-back-off-between-retries) between attempts. |

For what a specific error means on your screen, see [Troubleshooting](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/troubleshooting).

## Errors

Source: <https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/errors>

Every error response has the same shape:

```json Example error
{
  "error": {
    "type": "order_error",
    "code": "order_rejected",
    "message": "The broker or the exchange rejected this order.",
    "reject_reason": "insufficient_funds",
    "order": "ord_4vq7zk2m5xw3pn6rtd2a",
    "doc_url": "https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/errors#order_rejected"
  }
}
```

Use `code` to handle errors in your integration. `message` is a description for people and can change, so don't match on it. When an error relates to a specific field, `param` names that field. When the broker or the exchange rejects an order, an application or an allocation, `reject_reason` gives the reason. When an error is about one of your orders, applications or allocations, `order`, `application` or `allocation` gives its ID, so you can retrieve it. The `message` shown for each code below is its short form. A response can carry a longer `message` that names the object and what to do.

| Code | Status | Type |
|---|---|---|
| [`invalid_request`](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/errors#invalid_request) | 400 | `invalid_request_error` |
| [`missing_required_field`](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/errors#missing_required_field) | 400 | `invalid_request_error` |
| [`unknown_account`](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/errors#unknown_account) | 400 | `invalid_request_error` |
| [`unauthorized`](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/errors#unauthorized) | 401 | `authentication_error` |

### invalid_request

`400` `invalid_request_error`

The request could not be read.

**What to do.** Fix what the message describes, or the field `param` names, and send the request again.

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: No. Fix the request. You can reuse the key.

### missing_required_field

`400` `invalid_request_error`

A required field is missing.

**What to do.** Add the field `param` names, and send the request again.

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: No. Fix the request. You can reuse the key.

### unknown_account

`400` `invalid_request_error`

The account is not registered to you.

**What to do.** Answered for an account in a request body, and for the account in the path of its balance, positions, trades and contract notes. Use one of your account codes: `GET /v1/accounts` lists them.

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: No. Fix the request. You can reuse the key.

### unauthorized

`401` `authentication_error`

Invalid credentials.

**What to do.** Check the key: it must be for this environment's host, unexpired and not revoked, and a live key must come from an address you registered. See [Keys and security](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/keys-and-security).

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: No. Nothing was done. Fix the API key or its scope, then send it again with the same `Idempotency-Key`.

### feature_not_enabled

`403` `permission_error`

This feature is not enabled on this gateway. Sending the request again will not change the result. [Contact us](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support).

**What to do.** [Contact us](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support). Account opening and deposits are enabled for every partner on a gateway, or for none. Once we enable deposits, send a refused allocation again with a new key: its own key keeps returning `403`.

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: An application: no. An allocation: yes, as refused. [Contact us](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support). Sending it again does not change the result.

### insufficient_scope

`403` `permission_error`

This API key does not have the scope this request requires. Nothing was done.

**What to do.** Use a key that has the scope the message names, or create one in your partner portal. See [Keys and security](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/keys-and-security#scopes).

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: No. Nothing was done. Fix the API key or its scope, then send it again with the same `Idempotency-Key`.

### account_not_found

`404` `invalid_request_error`

No such account.

**What to do.** Answered only by `GET /v1/accounts/{account}`. Check the code: `GET /v1/accounts` lists yours.

### allocation_not_found

`404` `invalid_request_error`

No such allocation.

**What to do.** Check the allocation ID.

### application_not_found

`404` `invalid_request_error`

No such application.

**What to do.** Check the application ID.

### not_found

`404` `invalid_request_error`

No such path. Check the path against the API reference.

**What to do.** Check the path against the API reference.

### order_not_found

`404` `invalid_request_error`

No such order.

**What to do.** Check the order ID. An order another partner placed is not found either.

### method_not_allowed

`405` `invalid_request_error`

This method is not allowed on this path.

**What to do.** Use a method the `Allow` header lists.

### account_not_at_broker

`409` `invalid_request_error`

The broker does not recognise this account. No change is needed on your side. [Contact us](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support) to resolve it.

**What to do.** [Contact us](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support) with the `x-request-id`.

**A code, or a reject reason.** We answer `409 account_not_at_broker` to a read of an account the broker doesn't recognise: its balance, positions, trades or contract notes. An order or an allocation for such an account is `rejected` with `reject_reason` `account_not_at_broker` instead, and its key is spent.

### application_not_accepting_documents

`409` `invalid_request_error`

This application does not take documents in its state. Nothing was sent.

**What to do.** Read the application's `state`. If it's `uncertain` or `sending`, wait, and send the documents once it's `documents_required`. Otherwise it takes no more documents.

### document_already_delivered

`409` `invalid_request_error`

The broker already has a different file of this type for this application. Nothing was sent.

**What to do.** [Contact us](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support) to replace a document the broker has.

### document_in_flight

`409` `invalid_request_error`

This document is being sent to the broker. Send it again shortly.

Sent with `Retry-After: 1`.

**What to do.** Wait the `Retry-After` interval, then send the same file again.

### duplicate_allocation

`409` `idempotency_error`

This Idempotency-Key already belongs to a different allocation.

**What to do.** Read the allocation `allocation` names before you send anything with a new key.

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: Yes, under another request. Read the resource the error's `order`, `application` or `allocation` names before you send anything with a new key. It may be the one you intended.

### duplicate_application

`409` `idempotency_error`

This Idempotency-Key already belongs to a different application.

**What to do.** Read the application `application` names before you send anything with a new key.

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: Yes, under another request. Read the resource the error's `order`, `application` or `allocation` names before you send anything with a new key. It may be the one you intended.

### duplicate_order

`409` `idempotency_error`

This Idempotency-Key already belongs to a different order.

**What to do.** Read the order `order` names. If it is the order you intended, it is already placed. Otherwise, send the new order with a new key.

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: Yes, under another request. Read the resource the error's `order`, `application` or `allocation` names before you send anything with a new key. It may be the one you intended.

### earlier_document_unconfirmed

`409` `invalid_request_error`

The broker did not confirm receipt of an earlier file of this type. Nothing was sent. Send that earlier file again.

**What to do.** Send the earlier file again, the same bytes: the broker's answer to it settles the type. To send a different file instead, [contact us](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support).

### order_not_cancelable

`409` `order_error`

This order cannot be cancelled.

**What to do.** Read the order to see why: a market order, an order already final, one not yet confirmed at the exchange, or a cancel the broker refused. See [Cancel an order](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/trade#5-cancel-an-order).

### similar_allocation_unresolved

`409` `wallet_error`

An allocation to this account for this amount is not yet resolved.

**What to do.** Retrieve the allocation `allocation` names until it resolves. If it becomes `booked`, the account is funded: send yours again with the same key only if it is a separate allocation, not a repeat of that one. Its `id` and `client_reference` identify it in your records. If it becomes `rejected`, send yours again with the same key. See [Identical allocations](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/handling-uncertain#identical-allocations-while-one-is-unresolved).

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: No. You can reuse the key once the earlier allocation resolves. See [Identical allocations](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/handling-uncertain#identical-allocations-while-one-is-unresolved).

### similar_order_unresolved

`409` `order_error`

An identical order on this account is not yet resolved.

**What to do.** Retrieve the order `order` names until it resolves. If it becomes `pending`, `partially_filled` or `filled`, the exchange has it: send yours again with the same key only if it is a separate order, not a repeat of that one. If it becomes `rejected`, `refused` or `cancelled`, check its `filled_quantity`, then send yours again with the same key if you still want it. See [Identical orders](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/handling-uncertain#identical-orders-while-one-is-unresolved).

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: No. You can reuse the key once the earlier order resolves. See [Identical orders](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/handling-uncertain#identical-orders-while-one-is-unresolved).

### document_too_large

`413` `invalid_request_error`

The document is 1,000,000 bytes or more. Nothing was sent.

**What to do.** Send the document smaller than 1,000,000 bytes. See [Send the documents](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/applications#send-the-documents).

### request_too_large

`413` `invalid_request_error`

The request body exceeds the size limit.

**What to do.** Send a smaller body. See [Limits](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/limits).

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: No. Fix the request. You can reuse the key.

### unsupported_media_type

`415` `invalid_request_error`

Content-Type must be application/json.

**What to do.** Send the body as JSON, with `Content-Type: application/json`; a document as the file itself, with `Content-Type: image/jpeg` or `image/png`.

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: No. Fix the request. You can reuse the key.

### allocation_rejected

`422` `wallet_error`

The broker rejected this allocation. Its amount has been returned to the wallet.

**What to do.** Act on `reject_reason`: see [Allocation reject reasons](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/errors#allocation_reject_reasons).

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: Yes, as rejected. To try again, send a corrected request with a new key.

### application_rejected

`422` `application_error`

The broker rejected this application.

**What to do.** Act on `reject_reason` and `param`: see [Application reject reasons](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/errors#application_reject_reasons).

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: Yes, as rejected. To try again, send a corrected request with a new key.

### document_rejected

`422` `application_error`

The broker refused this document. Nothing was delivered. [Contact us](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support).

**What to do.** Correct the file and send it again. If it's refused again, [contact us](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support) with the application's `id` and the document's type.

### invalid_document

`422` `invalid_request_error`

The file is not the image its Content-Type says, or is too large to show. Nothing was sent.

**What to do.** Send a JPEG or PNG, with the Content-Type of what it is, at most 8,000 pixels wide and high. `param` is `body`.

### limit_exceeded

`422` `limit_error`

This request would exceed your daily limit. Nothing was written and nothing was sent.

**What to do.** Wait until the limit resets at midnight, West Africa Time (WAT). A single order or allocation larger than the whole daily limit never fits: split it, or [ask us](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support) to change the limit. See [Limits](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/limits).

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: No. You can reuse the key once your limit or your wallet allows the request.

### order_rejected

`422` `order_error`

The broker or the exchange rejected this order.

**What to do.** Act on `reject_reason`: see [Order reject reasons](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/errors#order_reject_reasons).

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: Yes, as rejected. To try again, send a corrected request with a new key.

### too_many_keys

`422` `limit_error`

This would leave your company more than 10 working API keys. Nothing was changed.

**What to do.** Answered only in your partner portal, when you create a key or rotate one with an overlap. Revoke a key you no longer use, then try again. A rotation with no overlap ends the old key as it issues the new one, so it adds no key and is never refused for this.

### unknown_symbol

`422` `order_error`

The broker does not list this symbol. Nothing was written and nothing was sent.

**What to do.** Check the symbol. Nothing was stored, so you can send a corrected order with the same key.

**A code, or a reject reason.** We answer `422 unknown_symbol` before we store anything, for a market order or a sell whose symbol the broker's price list doesn't have, so you can send a corrected order with the same key. A limit buy isn't checked before we store it: if the broker refuses its symbol, the order is `rejected` with `reject_reason` `unknown_symbol` instead, and its key is spent.

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: No. Fix the request. You can reuse the key.

### wallet_too_low

`422` `wallet_error`

The wallet's available balance is less than this amount. Nothing was written and nothing was sent.

**What to do.** Allocate less, or wait for a credit to your wallet. See [Wallet](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/wallet).

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: No. You can reuse the key once your limit or your wallet allows the request.

### rate_limited

`429` `rate_limit_error`

Too many requests. Nothing was done. Send the same request again after the Retry-After interval.

Sent with `Retry-After: 1`.

**What to do.** Wait the `Retry-After` interval, then send the same request again. See [Limits](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/limits).

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: No. Wait the `Retry-After` interval, then send it again with the same key.

### internal_error

`500` `api_error`

The gateway encountered an internal error. Send the same request again, exactly as you sent it.

**What to do.** Send the same request again, exactly as you sent it. If it keeps failing, [contact us](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support) with the `x-request-id`.

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: Maybe. Send the same request with the same key. Never a new key.

### exchange_error

`502` `api_error`

The exchange returned a response the gateway cannot process. Nothing was changed. Sending the request again will not change the result. [Contact us](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support).

**What to do.** [Contact us](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support) with the `x-request-id`. Sending it again does not change the result.

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: No. [Contact us](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support). Sending it again does not change the result.

### allocation_not_sent

`503` `api_error`

The allocation was recorded but could not be sent. It never reached the broker.

**What to do.** The allocation is recorded as never sent, its amount has been returned to your wallet, and its key is spent. Send it again with a new key.

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: Yes, as never sent. Send it again with a new key.

### application_not_sent

`503` `api_error`

The application was recorded but could not be sent. It never reached the broker.

**What to do.** The application is recorded as never sent, and its key is spent. Send it again with a new key.

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: Yes, as never sent. Send it again with a new key.

### cancel_unconfirmed

`503` `api_error`

Cancel unconfirmed: the broker did not confirm receipt of the cancel request. Send it again. Repeating a cancel request is safe.

**What to do.** Send the cancel again, or read the order: it becomes `cancelled` once the exchange confirms.

### document_unconfirmed

`503` `api_error`

Document unconfirmed: the broker did not confirm receipt of the document. Send the same file again. Sending the same file again is safe.

**What to do.** Send the same file again. It is sent to the broker again, and the broker's answer settles the document.

### exchange_unavailable

`503` `api_error`

The broker cannot be reached. Nothing was written and nothing was sent. Send the request again, with the same Idempotency-Key if it has one.

**What to do.** Send the same request again, with the same `Idempotency-Key` if it has one, backing off as [Handle errors](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/handle-errors#4-back-off-between-retries) says. Nothing was sent.

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: No. Send it again with the same key.

### order_not_sent

`503` `api_error`

The order was recorded but could not be sent. It never reached the exchange.

**What to do.** The order is recorded as never sent, and its key is spent. Send the order again with a new key.

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: Yes, as never sent. Send it again with a new key.

### outcome_not_recorded

`503` `api_error`

Your request reached us, and its outcome was not recorded.

**What to do.** Retrieve the order, application or allocation the error names, or wait for its event, until it resolves. It reads `sending` until then and may already be at the broker, so don't send it again under a new key. See [Handle an uncertain result](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/handling-uncertain).

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: Yes, as sending. Retrieve the resource the error's `order`, `application` or `allocation` names until it resolves. Don't send it again under a new key.

### service_unavailable

`503` `api_error`

The gateway is temporarily unable to process this request. Send the same request again, with the same Idempotency-Key if it has one.

**What to do.** Send the same request again, with the same `Idempotency-Key` if it has one.

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: Maybe. Send the same request with the same key. Never a new key.

### settlement_lockout

`503` `api_error`

Temporarily unavailable: the broker is settling the day's trades. Send the request again after the Retry-After interval.

Sent with `Retry-After: 60`.

**What to do.** Send the request again after the `Retry-After` interval.

**A code, or a reject reason.** We answer `503 settlement_lockout` to a read while the broker settles the day's trades. The broker applies the lockout to the cash balance, the estimate and placing an order, and to withdrawals, which are not in the API yet; we pass it through on any broker read if the broker sends one. An estimate or an order meets it as `422 order_rejected` with `reject_reason` `settlement_lockout`, and an allocation as `allocation_rejected` with the same reason.

### trading_paused

`503` `api_error`

New orders, applications, documents and allocations are paused. Nothing was written and nothing was sent. Cancels, estimates and reads still work. Send it again after the Retry-After interval.

Sent with `Retry-After: 60`.

**What to do.** Wait the `Retry-After` interval, then send it again, with the same key where it has one. Cancels, estimates and reads still work.

**Your `Idempotency-Key`.** Stored: No. Wait the `Retry-After` interval, then send it again with the same key.

### Order reject reasons

When you receive `order_rejected`, or an order is in the `rejected` state, `reject_reason` has one of these values.

| `reject_reason` | What it means | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| `account_not_at_broker` | The broker does not recognise this account. | No change is needed on your side. [Contact us](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support) to resolve it. |
| `etf_limit_orders_only` | An ETF takes limit orders only. | Send a limit order, with a new Idempotency-Key. |
| `insufficient_funds` | The account's balance does not cover this order. | Fund the account, then send the order with a new Idempotency-Key. |
| `limit_orders_etf_only` | Retired. Before 1 October 2026 the sandbox rejected a limit order on a share with this reason; no order is rejected with it now. An ETF takes limit orders only: `etf_limit_orders_only`. | Nothing: an order rejected before then keeps it. |
| `market_closed` | The market is closed. | Send the order with a new Idempotency-Key when it opens. |
| `rejected_by_exchange` | The exchange rejected this order. | Sending it again will not change the result. [Contact us](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support) with the order ID. If the order was uncertain before it was rejected, nothing traded: the broker refused it or it expired. You can place it again with a new Idempotency-Key, and if it is rejected again, [contact us](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support). |
| `settlement_lockout` | The broker is settling the day's trades. | Wait 60 seconds, then send the order with a new Idempotency-Key. |
| `symbol_not_tradable` | This symbol cannot be traded at present. | Send the order with a new Idempotency-Key on a later trading day. If the rejection recurs, [contact us](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support). |
| `unknown_symbol` | The broker does not list this symbol. | Check the symbol, then send the order with a new Idempotency-Key. The exchange publishes the lists of its symbols. |

### Application reject reasons

When you receive `application_rejected`, or an application is in the `rejected` state, `reject_reason` has one of these values.

| `reject_reason` | What it means | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| `already_at_broker` | The broker already holds this customer, or an application for them. | Sending it again will not change the result. [Contact us](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support). |
| `declined_by_broker` | The broker declined this application after accepting it. | [Contact us](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support) before you send it again. |
| `invalid_field` | The broker did not accept a field; `param` names it. | Correct the field, then send the application with a new Idempotency-Key. |
| `rejected_by_broker` | The broker rejected this application. | [Contact us](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support) before you send it again. |

### Allocation reject reasons

When you receive `allocation_rejected`, or an allocation is in the `rejected` state, `reject_reason` has one of these values.

| `reject_reason` | What it means | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| `account_not_at_broker` | The broker does not recognise this account. The amount has been returned to your wallet. | No change is needed on your side. [Contact us](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support) to resolve it. |
| `closed_financial_year` | The broker does not accept deposits while its financial year is closed. The amount has been returned to your wallet. | [Contact us](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support) to learn when to send it again. |
| `invalid_amount` | The broker did not accept this amount. The amount has been returned to your wallet. | Check the amount, then send the allocation with a new Idempotency-Key. |
| `not_booked` | Our operations team confirmed with the broker that it did not book this allocation. The amount has been returned to your wallet. | If you still want it, send it again with a new Idempotency-Key. |
| `rejected_by_broker` | The broker rejected this allocation. The amount has been returned to your wallet. | [Contact us](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support) before you send it again. |
| `settlement_lockout` | The broker is settling the day's trades. The amount has been returned to your wallet. | Wait 60 seconds, then send the allocation again with a new Idempotency-Key. |

## Troubleshooting

Source: <https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/troubleshooting>

Find the symptom, check each cause in turn, and follow the link for the full rule. If none fits, [send us](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support#report-a-problem) the response's `x-request-id`.

### 401 unauthorized

A key sent to the other environment's host gets a message that says so. Every other problem with the key itself returns the same `401`, so the response never tells someone holding a stolen key whether it's valid. A valid key without the scope a request needs gets `403 insufficient_scope` instead, naming the scope. Check each cause of a `401`:

- The header is `Authorization: Bearer` followed by the key.
- The key belongs to this host: sandbox keys work only on the sandbox host, and live keys only on the live host.
- In live, the request comes from an address registered for the key. If live requests start failing, check whether your servers' outbound addresses have changed. New addresses need a new key.
- The key hasn't expired at the end of a rotation, or been revoked.

When the cause is the address, our log records it: [send us](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support#report-a-problem) the response's `x-request-id`. See [Keys and security](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/keys-and-security).

We check the path and the method before the key, so a request to a path we don't serve gets `404 not_found`, and one with the wrong method gets `405 method_not_allowed`, with or without a key. The one exception is `/v1/orders/estimate`, which accepts `POST` only: another method there is read as an order `id`.

### A webhook signature doesn't match

- You used the body bytes exactly as they arrived. A framework that parses the JSON and writes it out again changes them.
- You base64 decoded the part of the secret after `whsec_` and used those bytes as the key.
- You signed the `webhook-id`, the `webhook-timestamp` and the body, joined by full stops, in that order.
- You used this environment's secret. The sandbox and live endpoints have different secrets.
- You checked every entry in `webhook-signature`. During a secret rotation there are two.

Run your code against the [test vector](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/webhooks#test-your-verification). If it passes there and fails on real events, the bytes are changing before your check.

### An order is uncertain or stays sending

Don't place it again under a new key: it may already be at the exchange. Wait for its next event, or retrieve it. See [Handle an uncertain result](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/handling-uncertain).

### An allocation is uncertain or stays sending

Don't send it again under a new key: the broker may already have booked it. Wait for its next event, or retrieve it. See [Identical allocations](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/handling-uncertain#identical-allocations-while-one-is-unresolved).

### An application is uncertain or stays sending

Don't send it again under a new key: the broker refuses a second application for the same customer. Wait for its next event, or retrieve it. See [Applications and allocations](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/handling-uncertain#applications-and-allocations).

### A 409

| Code | What happened | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| `duplicate_order`, `duplicate_application`, `duplicate_allocation` | You reused an `Idempotency-Key` with a different request. | Retrieve the object the error's `order`, `application` or `allocation` names. It may be the one you intended. If not, send your request with a new key. |
| `similar_order_unresolved` | An identical order on the same account is unresolved. | Retrieve the order the error's `order` names until it resolves. See [Identical orders](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/handling-uncertain#identical-orders-while-one-is-unresolved). |
| `similar_allocation_unresolved` | An allocation to the same account for the same amount is unresolved. | Retrieve the allocation the error's `allocation` names until it resolves. See [Identical allocations](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/handling-uncertain#identical-allocations-while-one-is-unresolved). |
| `order_not_cancelable` | The order can't be cancelled now. | Retrieve it to see its state. See [Cancel an order](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/trade#5-cancel-an-order). |
| `account_not_at_broker` | The broker doesn't recognise the account. | [Contact us](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support). No change is needed on your side. |
| `document_in_flight`, `earlier_document_unconfirmed`, `document_already_delivered`, `application_not_accepting_documents` | A document for this type is on its way, or unconfirmed, or the broker has another; or the application isn't taking documents. | See [Send the documents](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/applications#send-the-documents). |

### A 503

The request didn't complete. Codes ending in `_not_sent` were stored as never sent, so send the request again with a new key. For `outcome_not_recorded`, retrieve the order, application or allocation the error names until it resolves, and don't send it again under a new key. Every other `503` takes the same request again: with the same key where the request has one, after the `Retry-After` seconds where the response has that header, and [backing off](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/handle-errors#4-back-off-between-retries) where it doesn't. [When to use a new key](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/idempotency#when-to-use-a-new-key) lists each code.

A `503 exchange_unavailable` on a read of balances, positions, trades or contract notes can also mean the broker is busy with other reads. See [Reads that ask the broker](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/limits#reads-that-ask-the-broker).

### An event didn't arrive

- An endpoint is registered in this environment. Events from before registration are only in `GET /v1/events`.
- Your endpoint answered `2xx` in time. If not, we retry on the [schedule](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/webhooks#retries), and failures in a row pause your endpoint.
- There's no event for `sending`, and every other state has one.
- The event is in `GET /v1/events`, whatever happened to its delivery. [Catch up](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/webhooks#catch-up-on-missed-events) from your stored cursor.

If we stopped retrying events while your endpoint was down, [ask us](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support) to send them again.

### An application stays documents_required or submitted

While it's `documents_required`, the broker is waiting for the customer's four documents: [send them](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/applications#send-the-documents). Once they're `submitted`, its staff decide how long their review takes. For how long we check on it, see [Wait for the account to open](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/applications#4-wait-for-the-account-to-open).

### A payment isn't in your wallet

See [Find the credit](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/funding#2-find-the-credit).

### 429 or 422 limit_exceeded

You've reached a limit. `GET /v1/limits` shows what's left. See [Limits](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/limits).
